Received at a post office, distribution centre or operations office.

entries.note: Arrived at the destination's office of exchange, waiting for customs. An arrival abroad, relayed from the foreign post, has the same wording.

Customs released the item. ParcelsApp lists it among Correos de México's statuses; not yet seen on the tracker.
Left at the office's counter for collection. After the item was sent back, it waits there for the sender.
After the item was sent back, the delivery is to the sender, which the adapter reads as a return.
Delivered abroad, as the destination post reports.
